# Which screens to photograph, and in which appearance.
#
# Edit this file and commit — the Preview screens workflow runs on the change and
# posts the shots into its job log (and as artifacts). GitHub's web editor works
# fine from a phone.

# screens:    studio, home, archive, course, summit, yearbook, prints, wall-art,

#             wall-art accepts a style: wall-art:grid, wall-art:ridgeline, wall-art:rings,
#             wall-art:thread, wall-art:strata
#             print-engine runs the print writer's self-check and reports pass/fail
# appearance: light, dark, or both

# legibility. home in both appearances — the light shot is the one that matters, because a white
# halo under dark chrome is the half of this that is easy to get wrong.

# screens: a product tile can be named directly, e.g. studio@lithograph
